svg.text: any topic · a team sized to the question · Claude · Codex · Antigravity · Kiro
in parallel · own context · web tools only
dense notes: one fact per bullet + its link
only the researchers the review sent back
fix it, support it, or call it a gap
judges the revised notes, then a last revise
The orchestrator writes notes.md and chooses one direction:
what is established · patterns · dead ends · open questions
Every decision goes into log.md with its reason.
new cycle: new researchers + a reviewer
a writer in a clean context
every fact with its source inline
anything else is listed to fix
A DEGREE SETS THE MODELS AND THE DEPTH
fast models · you write the document
Researchers are spread over the providers you have; a provider that fails or hits a limit is replaced by the next one, mid-run.
